source_snapshot.procedure: Review General information, FW Version, New features/defect fixed and Known issue in the release note.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information is readable without spelling error, FW Version is correct, and the new-feature/fix/known-issue descriptions are clear.
source_snapshot.script: Private `check_fw_version_by_ipmitool_raw.git` reference does not implement the four-section document review. Ten minutes attended and ten machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO for documentation review, but its log output incorrectly imports the duplicate row's BIOS Change Value/Option action.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; supports hashing, rendering, extraction and cross-checks, retains owner semantic judgment, and prohibits BIOS UI/flash actions.

old_problem: The Master Items, Procedure and Criteria define a four-section release-note review, while the private script is only an IPMI raw firmware-version check and DeepSeek's log instruction belongs to Functionality row 356 / variant d3bbb296e6c1b52e (`Change Opt.`). The prior record preserved these as source conflict and asked engineering to decide script ownership even though neither alternate path can satisfy General Information, features/fixes and Known Issues. Exact package/document identity and authoritative change records are ordinary supplied inputs.
disposition_reason: Case-specific source semantics are unambiguous: review the exact release note itself. Preserve but quarantine the IPMI script and duplicate BIOS key-action text because they cannot observe three of the four named document sections and would introduce unauthorized DUT activity. The test hashes and renders the original artifact, extracts every page, validates General Information and exact FW Version against the package manifest/image metadata, traces every new feature/fix/known issue to approved records, applies an approved technical dictionary and clarity schema, and emits cited discrepancies. Supplying the package, note, language policy and owner baselines is runtime configuration. The deterministic document pipeline is FULLY AUTOMATABLE; the release owner still owns exception approval and the formal verdict under ED-38, which does not reduce automation capability.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1455, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, selection manifest and duplicate row 356 review were read directly. The next formal queue identity was independently verified as Functionality row 1492 / variant 16232244363a8db4.

Items, During Test and all three Criteria consistently identify the object under test as the release-note document. The private script name exposes only a runtime firmware version, and DeepSeek's Change Value/Option instruction exactly matches the separately reviewed row-356 manual BIOS-key case.

A runtime version read can supplement a later firmware validation but cannot prove the note's general information, new features, fixed defects, known issues, spelling, layout or clarity. Running it here would reduce coverage and violate the documentation-only safety boundary.

Artifact identity is foundational: bind release-note hash, package/image hash, package release identifier, target board/product/revision and expected firmware version to the same approved release. A readable note for another target cannot pass.

Readability requires both text extraction and page rendering. Extraction alone can miss clipped tables, broken fonts, encoding, hidden text or image-only pages; OCR output remains secondary to the immutable original and rendered page evidence.
Spelling checks use an owner-approved language and technical/vendor dictionary. Unknown terms are findings, not automatically errors; all flagged/ignored terms retain page/line context and rationale.

Clarity/completeness is made reviewable through a Project schema: each feature/fix/known issue has a stable ID, affected component/version, concise behavior or symptom, condition/scope, disposition and workaround/limitation where applicable. The owner resolves policy exceptions, while the pipeline deterministically reports absent or contradictory fields.

A blank Known Issues section is not equivalent to none. The release authority must explicitly state `None` or provide the complete approved list; each fix/change reference must reconcile with the release baseline and unresolved items cannot be hidden.

No DUT logs are relevant to validating an offline document, so the generic source log-clear instruction is rejected and no BIOS/UI/IPMI/flash action is permitted. The package remains unapproved for downstream use until discrepancies are resolved.

ED-02/ED-21 preserve the duplicate Source Key/variant; ED-03/ED-04/ED-10 make supplied artifacts inputs rather than partial work; ED-17/ED-19 prevent tool substitution and coverage loss; ED-26 prohibits automatic artifact substitution; ED-33/ED-35 preserve Master and all four sections; ED-36 separates readiness; ED-38 reserves final release verdict.

test_case.test_name: BIOS firmware package release-note four-section traceability and readability review
test_case.purpose: Verify that the immutable release note paired with the exact BIOS firmware package is readable and correctly spelled, identifies the correct target/version, and clearly and completely documents General Information, New Features/Defects Fixed and Known Issues against approved release records, without touching a DUT.
required_package: Original release-note artifact in its authoritative format plus filename/revision/date/source/signature or hash, exact BIOS package/image identifiers and cryptographic hashes, target product/board/revision and release manifest
Authoritative expected firmware version and image metadata; approved change/feature/fix tickets, known-issue register, release baseline and disposition records that define completeness
Approved document renderer and text extractor/OCR appropriate to the format, versioned technical language/spelling dictionary, readability/clarity schema and deterministic comparison/report tool
Protected read-only working/evidence location, page/section citation policy, artifact retention rules and release-owner exception/verdict workflow
test_case.test_command: OFFLINE DOCUMENT PIPELINE; DO NOT ACCESS A DUT. Copy the owner-supplied release note and package manifest/image metadata into a read-only evidence workspace, record size/mtime/source and calculate approved cryptographic hashes without modifying the originals. Verify signature/provenance where supplied and prove the note, package, target board/product/revision and release ID are one release. Render every page and extract text with page/section coordinates; if OCR is needed, retain both image and OCR confidence/output. Locate exactly four required sections—General Information, FW Version, New Features/Defect Fixed and Known Issues—and fail closed on missing, blank, truncated or duplicate-ambiguous sections. Compare the stated firmware version/target/package ID with the authoritative manifest and image metadata. Build a cited matrix for every feature, fixed defect and known issue against approved IDs, affected component/version, scope/condition, outcome and workaround/limitation; require an explicit authority-backed `None` when no known issues exist. Run spelling/grammar/readability checks with the approved technical dictionary, record every finding/suppression and validate page rendering for clipped/garbled content. Re-hash originals, emit a deterministic section/field/discrepancy report and leave final exception acceptance/verdict to the release owner. Do not invoke the private IPMI script, BIOS `+/-`, log clear or flash.
test_case.expected_result: The unchanged release note is cryptographically bound to the exact target BIOS package/release; every page renders and extracts readably; all four required sections are present and non-ambiguous; target and firmware version exactly match authoritative package/image metadata; every feature/fix/known issue entry is clear, complete and traceable to the approved records; and spelling/readability findings are zero or explicitly owner-approved with cited rationale. No DUT, BIOS, IPMI, log or firmware action occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Automated Tool Result PASS requires immutable matching note/package identity, complete rendering/extraction of every page, all four sections, exact target/version match, complete one-to-one feature/fix/known-issue traceability, explicit authority-backed no-issue statement when applicable, and no unresolved spelling/layout/clarity-schema finding. FAIL covers a supplied artifact that is wrong/stale/unreadable, mismatched to package/target/version, missing a required section/record, contradictory or unclear, or changes hash during review. NOT READY covers an unsupplied authoritative note/package/manifest/change/issue baseline, renderer or dictionary. IPMI output, BIOS key behavior or another variant cannot pass. The release owner records exceptions and final verdict separately; no hardware PASS is claimed.
safety_gate: Operate only on read-only copies and preserve original document/package metadata and hashes. Never edit the note to make a check pass or silently substitute a corrected/stale revision.
Do not contact a DUT, run IPMI raw, open BIOS Setup, press Change Option keys, clear logs, flash firmware, reset or reboot. Those actions do not belong to this document case.
Bind by exact Source Key/variant and artifact identities; code-only lookup could select row 356's unrelated manual BIOS option case.
Treat OCR, spell/grammar and readability scores as evidence, not hidden auto-correction. Preserve page images, extracted text, confidence and every technical-dictionary exception.

Fail closed on cross-platform/version mismatch, incomplete known-issue authority, missing/clipped content, unresolved contradiction or changed hash; block downstream package approval until corrected artifacts are supplied.
Do not automatically fetch an alternate Internet/vendor document or rerun against a new revision as the same attempt. A replacement gets a new hash and review identity.
The review agent may produce the offline Tool Result but does not issue the owner's release approval or DUT verdict.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; release-note filename/revision/date/source/hash/signature; BIOS package/image filename/release/hash; target product/board/revision and manifest identity
Tool/renderer/extractor/OCR/dictionary/schema versions and immutable every-page renders plus page-addressable extracted text/confidence
Four-section presence/completeness matrix and exact FW version/target/package expected-versus-observed comparison
Per-ID New Feature, Defect Fixed and Known Issue traceability with affected versions/components, scope/condition, result/workaround and authoritative record citations
Spelling/grammar/readability/layout findings and approved technical-term suppressions with page/line context
Final re-hashes, deterministic Tool Result/discrepancy report, release-owner exception/verdict placeholder and explicit no-DUT/no-flash/no-log-clear statement
test_case.recovery: If an artifact is missing, unreadable, mismatched, modified or internally contradictory, preserve its hash/render/extraction and all discrepancies, mark the package unapproved, and stop. Do not repair the original, infer missing known issues, substitute the private IPMI script, query a DUT or flash. Request a corrected owner-signed release note or authoritative records; treat the replacement as a new revision with new identity and rerun only under a new review attempt.

source_conflict.reason: The exact row's Items/Procedure/Criteria unanimously define release-note review. The IPMI script and duplicate Change Opt. output demonstrably cannot cover the four required sections, so they are preserved as mismatched historical references and excluded rather than requiring an engineering choice.

blocked.reason: The offline document method and acceptance are complete. Exact artifacts, baselines, language policy and owner exception rules are bounded inputs; their absence prevents a run but not the review definition.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact release note/package/image/target identities and hashes; authoritative version manifest, feature/fix tickets and known-issue register; document format renderer/OCR; approved technical dictionary and clarity/completeness schema; release-owner exception/verdict policy.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER OFFLINE DOCUMENT DEFINITION ONLY; NO RELEASE ARTIFACT REVIEW, IPMI, BIOS UI, LOG CLEAR, FLASH, REBOOT, DUT OR OTHER HARDWARE ACTION EXECUTED

project_authority: The firmware release owner supplies the authoritative package/note/version/change/known-issue set, language/dictionary/schema and approves justified exceptions plus the final release verdict. They cannot substitute runtime IPMI or BIOS key behavior for document coverage, waive a missing four-section trace, approve a mismatched artifact, edit evidence in place or treat static review as permission to flash.
